notes: The flip gate for vesper-gpu-compute's Vulkan runtime (aspect ci flip-gate --,
SH6 lane 1, #1396; this crate's lane: SH6 lane 15, #1410). The runtime
(Context, Buffer, Kernel, Recording, Submission) is the Vesper library in
vesper/; SH6 lane 15 deleted the Rust runtime over ash (part 2c). The
broadphase's and the tensor kernels' checks and dispatches, and the decode
step, are Vesper too (part 2b). The kernels are committed SPIR-V whose binding
interface the Vesper library reads; naga is only the tests' WGSL compiler
Every check needs a Vulkan device: run it on Mesa lavapipe
The runtime tests, the Tensor decoder and the broadphase against the CPU
references of vesper-tensor and vesper-kinetic (bit-exact pair sets,
matching tokens), the same tests the Rust runtime passed.
A B B A in fresh processes against the Rust runtime at its last commit;
both arms must print the same digest.
